name: Cloudinary
desc: Cloudinary is a cloud-based image and video management platform that allows you to upload, store, manage, and deliver your media assets. It provides a range of features for image and video optimization, transformation, and delivery.

actions.name: uploadResource
actions.description: Upload a new image, video, or file to Cloudinary.

actions.name: deleteResource
actions.description: Permanently delete images, videos, or files from Cloudinary.

actions.name: createUsageReport
actions.description: Generate a comprehensive report of account usage and quotas including storage, bandwidth, transformations, requests, and add-on usage.

actions.name: findResourceByPublicId
actions.description: Retrieve details of an asset using its unique public ID.

actions.name: transformResource
actions.description: Apply transformations (resize, crop, watermark, etc.) to an asset and generate a new URL.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

triggers.name: new_resource
triggers.description: Triggers when a new image, video, or file is uploaded to a specific folder or account in Cloudinary.

triggers.name: new_tag_added_to_asset
triggers.description: Triggers when a tag is added to an asset in Cloudinary.

guides.title: Cloudinary automation
guides.excerpt: Read our quick guide on Cloudinary automation. Discover how it works, explore common use cases, and learn how Activepieces can help.
